goal: Decide how UORust records a Rust target by the effect it reaches, so every capability becomes a modeled threat and nothing is silently pure.

app.name: capability-route
app.title: Capability route
app.purpose: Decide whether a Rust target is recorded as pure, as pure under the compiler gate, as a capability, or as a threat, from the first effect it reaches and whether its crate forbids unsafe code.

fields.name: effect
fields.means: the first operating-system effect the target reaches

meanings.pure: no effect: lifted as pure behavior, its memory threat controlled by review
meanings.gated: no effect: pure, its memory threat controlled by the forbid(unsafe_code) compiler gate
meanings.capability: an fs, net, process or env asset with a threat and reviewed sites
meanings.threat: an unsafe or foreign effect: a memory-safety threat, elevation of privilege

rules.why: model/routes.toml UR-R14: an unsafe block is a memory-safety threat
model/routes.toml UR-R15: an extern block crosses the language boundary, a threat
crates/uorust/src/project.rs threats: with forbid(unsafe_code) the memory threat is controlled by a gate (UR-R20)
crates/uorust/src/project.rs threats: without forbid the control is Safe Rust only, a review

app.otherwiseWhy: model/routes.toml UR-R16 to UR-R19: fs, net, process and env uses are assets, each with a capability threat (project.rs capability_threat)

properties.why: an effect is never routed as pure
the compiler gate is evidence only where the crate forbids unsafe code

stakeholders.name: Rust developer
stakeholders.text: Models a Cargo workspace with UORust and needs every effect in it to show up as a capability or a threat.

stakeholders.name: Security reviewer
stakeholders.text: Reads the threat model UORust writes and needs every unsafe or foreign call to arrive as a threat, with gate evidence only where the compiler enforces it.

concerns.name: Honest evidence
concerns.text: A control cites a gate only where the compiler enforces it; otherwise it cites a review.

components.name: Cargo workspace
components.text: The workspace UORust reads through cargo metadata, Cargo.lock and syn, with source spans.

components.name: uorust CLI
components.text: crates/uorust, which ingests facts, routes them through model/routes.toml and writes the Prism model.

threats.name: Unsafe routed as pure
threats.text: A target that reaches unsafe code is recorded as pure, so its memory threat is missing.

control.name: Effects never pure
control.text: An effect is never answered pure, proved for every request, and the Rust router replays the same vectors.

threats.name: Gate claimed without forbid
threats.text: A memory control cites the compiler gate for a crate that does not forbid unsafe code.

control.name: Gate only with forbid
control.text: Gated is never answered without forbid, proved for every request.

threats.name: Effect hidden by a macro
threats.text: A procedural macro or build script reaches an effect the source scan does not see.
threats.accepted: UORust reads source spans with syn; what it cannot lift is recorded as residue in frontier.toml rather than routed.

quality.text: Each of the seven effect kinds has a route, with and without forbid.
quality.measureText: Of the seven effect kinds, those no rule or otherwise routes.
